finalText:
Swept all 11 files that reference `formatAmount`. Of 221 call sites, **17** still pass the second argument.

`src\reports\quarterly.js` has the most, with 5 legacy calls (`row.bundle`, `row.holdback`, `row.subtotal`, `row.surcharge`, `row.gross`, all at `, true`). The rest are spread thin: `invoice.js` and `exports.js` have 3 each, `monthly.js` and `cart.js` have 2 each, and `statement.js`/`receipt.js` have 1 each. `ledger.js`, `dashboard.js`, and `refunds.js` already call it single-argument.

Start the cleanup in `src\reports\quarterly.js` since it carries the biggest chunk.
